en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘I asked himasws about the ornaments, ‘Is there Zakāt regarding it?’ Heasws said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan ibn Yahya from ibn Muskan from Muhammad al- Halabiy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about Zakat and jewelry.
He (the Imam) said, ‘Zakat is not due on jewelries.’”
